questions.prompt: What is the capital city of People's Republic of China?

hints.nudge: A capital city is where a country’s government meets. The other three are capital cities too, of other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the People's Republic of China article.

questions.proof: The capital city is Beijing and Shanghai is the city with the most people living in it.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries shares a border with People's Republic of China?

hints.nudge: Two countries are neighbours when you can walk from one into the other. Picture People's Republic of China on the globe and look at what it touches.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Geography” part of the People's Republic of China article.

questions.proof: It borders Vietnam, Laos, and Burma in Southeast Asia; India, Bhutan, Nepal and Pakistan in South Asia; Afghanistan, Tajikistan, Kyrgyzstan and Kazakhstan in Central Asia; a small section of Russian Altai and Mongolia in Inner Asia; and the Russian Far East and North Korea in Northeast Asia.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “This was because _____ found a lot of silver in the newly explored continents of North and South America.”

hints.nudge: In the sentence the missing word sits beside “found”. It names one thing, not an action.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “A new age” part of the People's Republic of China article.

questions.proof: This was because Spain found a lot of silver in the newly explored continents of North and South America.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “China, the Nationalist party in particular, owed _____ immense amounts of money, which they could not pay whilst infused in their own civil war.”

hints.nudge: In the sentence the missing word sits beside “owed”. It names one thing, not an action.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “A new age” part of the People's Republic of China article.

questions.proof: China, the Nationalist party in particular, owed Japan immense amounts of money, which they could not pay whilst infused in their own civil war.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “The Nationalists (led by Chiang Kai-shek) fled to the island of _____ and set up their new capital city in Taipei.”

hints.nudge: In the sentence the missing word sits beside “island”. It names one thing, not an action.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “A new age” part of the People's Republic of China article.

questions.proof: The Nationalists (led by Chiang Kai-shek) fled to the island of Taiwan and set up their new capital city in Taipei.
